h: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן, מַאֲמָר א׳ Rosh Chodesh Nisan — Maamar Aleph

p: He made the letter Hei king in speech, etc.
and the right foot in the soul.
we call it the Oral Torah,"
which is the mouth of Hashem,
and this world was created with the letter Hei
the world was created in Nisan.
that "both these and those are the words of the living God,"
for in Tishrei it arose in thought to create,
and it was not actually created until Nisan,
and so it is written in Pri Etz Chaim.
And therefore this month was created with the letter Hei.
הֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֵלַי
'Behold, the Children of Israel have not listened to me,
and how will Pharaoh listen to me,
when I am of uncircumcised lips?'
'I am not a man of words, etc.,'
וְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא הֲוָה אוֹתִיב לֵיהּ
and the Holy One, blessed is He, answered him,
'when I am of uncircumcised lips, etc.'?
Moshe is the Voice, and Speech
and was blocked from expressing words.
'And how will Pharaoh listen to me'
בְּעוֹד דְּמִלָּה דִּילֵיהּ אִיהִי בְּגָלוּתָא וְכוּלֵּי"
while his Word is in exile, etc."
And this is according to what they said
כָּל אָדָם שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
"Any person who has fear of Heaven,
סוֹף דָּבָר הַכֹּל נִשְׁמָע אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים יְרָא וְגוֹמֵר.
"The sum of the matter, when all is heard: fear God, etc."
אַךְ מֹשֶׁה קְרָאוֹ לַיֵּצֶר הָרָע עָרֵל,
However, Moshe called the evil inclination "uncircumcised,"
"And you shall circumcise the foreskin of your heart"
הַיְינוּ דְּאַף שֶׁאֵין הָעָרְלָה קָרוּי אֶלָּא לְעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת
That is, although the term "uncircumcised" is applied only to idolaters
אַךְ הוּא יוֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ לֵב הַיִּשְׂרָאֵל
yet it sits inside the heart of the Jew
וּמְטַמְטֵם אֶת לִבּוֹ מִשְּׁמוֹעַ דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה.
and dulls his heart from hearing words of Torah.
was literally the mouth of Hashem,
כֵּן יִהְיֶה דְבָרִי אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִפִּי לֹא יָשׁוּב אֵלַי רֵיקָם וְגוֹמֵר.
"So shall My word be that goes forth from My mouth; it shall not return to Me empty, etc."
וְאִם לֹא הָיָה הַדִּבּוּר שֶׁלּוֹ בְּגָלוּת,
And had his speech not been in exile,
הָיוּ דְּבָרָיו נִכְנָסִין אַף לְלֵב פַּרְעֹה הָרָשָׁע.
his words would have entered even the heart of the wicked Pharaoh.
אַךְ כֵּיוָן שֶׁהָיָה הַדִּבּוּר שֶׁלּוֹ בְּגָלוּת,
However, since his speech was in exile
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁאָז הָיָה הַקְּלִיפָּה מַקֶּפֶת לְהַדִּבּוּר
meaning that at that time the spiritual husk surrounded the speech
this is what he meant when he said:
הֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֵלַי
"Behold, the Children of Israel have not listened to me,
and how will Pharaoh listen to me,
when I am of uncircumcised lips?"
for the foreskin surrounds the lips,
and my speech is in exile.
when the redemption of speech had already begun
for thus it is called Rosh Chodesh,
as it is the head for all the holiness of the month
He made the letter Hei king in speech.
and corresponding to this attribute is the Name Adonai,
"If I am a Master, where is My fear?"
where one stands before the King,
"HaKol" (in "The voice is the voice of Yaakov") is spelled deficiently without a Vav:
Kol with a Hei is the voice of prayer;
Kol with a Vav is the voice of Torah.
וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה הִתְחִילָה בִּנְיַן הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
And in this month began the building of Knesses Yisrael,
to recognize the Kingdom of Heaven.
And the blessings that Yaakov received were on Pesach,
אֶחָד עָשָׂה לְפֶסַח וְאֶחָד עָשָׂה מַטְעַמִּים.
"One he prepared for the Pesach offering, and one he prepared as delicacies."
And so it is written in the holy Zohar
בְּהַהוּא זִימְנָא עֶרֶב פֶּסַח הֲוָה וְכוּלֵּי.
"At that time it was Erev Pesach, etc."
And because of this he said to him then:
"The voice is the voice of Yaakov"
Kol with a Hei and Kol with a Vav:
the voice of Torah and the voice of prayer
שֶׁאָז בָּא זְמַן שֶׁיֵּצֵא הַדִּבּוּר מִגָּלוּת,
for then the time arrived for speech to emerge from exile,
as they wrote in the holy books:
Pesach is Peh Sach ("a mouth that speaks").
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁאָז נִפְתַּח פִּיהֶם לוֹמַר שִׁירָה עַל הַיָּם,
That is, then their mouths were opened to recite the Song at the Sea,
וְלָכֵן אָז בִּזְמַן זֶה זָכָה יַעֲקֹב לְקוֹל תּוֹרָה וְקוֹל תְּפִלָּה.
and therefore at that time Yaakov merited the voice of Torah and the voice of prayer.
שֶׁנָּתַן כֹּחַ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְנִיס קְדוּשָּׁה בַּחֹדֶשׁ.
for He gave power to Israel to bring holiness into the month.
For in the Written Torah we do not find holiness mentioned regarding the new month;
רַק בְּתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה מָצִינוּ בַּמִּשְׁנָה
only in the Oral Torah do we find in the Mishnah
"The head of the court says, 'It is sanctified,'
וְכָל הָעָם עוֹנִין אַחֲרָיו מְקוּדָּשׁ מְקוּדָּשׁ.
and all the people answer after him, 'It is sanctified, it is sanctified.'"
That is, then the holiness of Israel began,
and as they said in Midrash Rabbah
וְאִם כְּלִי חוֹל כְּשֶׁהוּא מִתְמַלֵּא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת,
"And if a mundane vessel, when it is filled with the sacred, becomes sanctified,
עַל אַחַת כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם קְדוֹשִׁים וּמְקַדְּשִׁים אֶת הַחֹדֶשׁ וְכוּלֵּי.
how much more so Israel, who are holy and sanctify the month, etc."

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Pri Tzaddik, Va'eira 8 — “The portion of Moshe Rabbeinu was the Written Torah, which he brought down from heaven, and then the Written Torah was still in the exile of Egypt. This is what he meant, that his speech was in exile; for had it not been in exile, his words would have been heard even by Pharaoh, who was uncircumcised of heart and of ear. Therefore the Holy One joined Aharon with him, whose portion was the Oral Torah, and Aharon's speech was not then in exile. All the time Israel was in Egypt speech was in exile, and speech in its completeness came only at the Giving of the Torah.” Connection: Both read “uncircumcised lips” as speech in exile that could otherwise have reached Pharaoh; Va'eira 8 identifies it as the Written Torah, explains Aharon's role through the Oral Torah, and places the full redemption of speech at Sinai.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Tzvi Elimelech of Dinov, Bnei Yissaschar, Maamarei Chodesh Nisan, Maamar 4:9 — “In exile the Shechinah, Malchus, is, as it were, ‘mute with silence,’ ‘like a ewe that is dumb before her shearers.’ For the essential awe of kingship comes from its speech, as it says, ‘The word of a king is dominion’; where there is no dominion, speech is struck dumb. On the night of freedom it is Peh Sach: the mouth began to speak, ‘Malchus is the mouth, we call it the Oral Torah.’ The final Hei of the Name is the Oral Torah, which in exile had no mouth, and what was sealed was opened on the night of freedom. This is ‘He made the letter Hei king in speech … and Nisan in the year.’” Connection: Like Rav Tzadok, he reads the Hei of Nisan as Malchus and the Oral Torah freed from exile; he adds that Malchus is silenced in exile because royal awe exists only through the king's spoken word.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Yehudah Aryeh Leib Alter, Sefas Emes, Bo 5656 — “‘This month shall be for you’: the Sages explained it as the sanctification of the month. What has this to do with the Exodus? It is the power of speech given to Israel, by which months and festivals are sanctified when the court says, ‘It is sanctified.’ At the Exodus Israel merited the covenant of the tongue; this is Pesach, Peh Sach, and ‘so that you may tell.’ Just as the covenant of the flesh brings new souls into the world, so the power of the mouth brings renewal: ‘I have put My words in your mouth … to plant the heavens.’ So Israel was handed the power to renew months through the holy tongue, and this was completed at the Exodus.” Connection: Both tie Israel's power to sanctify the month to the redemption of speech at Pesach; Sefas Emes adds that the freed mouth, like the covenant of circumcision, is a power of renewal, which is why it can make months new.

p: And this is the letter Hei in speech:
Malchus is the mouth, the Oral Torah.
And "the right foot in the soul"
even though speech has no apparent connection to the foot,
whereas in the month of Sivan, where it is stated,
הִמְלִיךְ אוֹת ז' בְּהִילוּךְ וְרֶגֶל שְׂמֹאל בַּנֶּפֶשׁ
"He made the letter Zayin king in walking, and the left foot in the soul,"
walking is fitting for a foot,
which is not the case with speech.
Yet in truth, with Hashem, may He be blessed,
we find walking associated with speech,
וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶת קוֹל ה' אֱלֹהִים מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּגָּן וְגוֹמֵר,
"And they heard the voice of Hashem God walking in the garden, etc.,"
וְכֵן דְּבָרִי אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִפִּי וְגוֹמֵר
and likewise, "My word that goes forth from My mouth, etc."
And even regarding Israel we find:
בְּתוֹרָה שֶׁהוּא בִּדְחִילוּ וּרְחִימוּ פָּרְחָא לְעֵילָּא.
"Through Torah that is with fear and love, it flies upward."
And regarding words of Torah we find:
אַשְׁרֵי תְמִימֵי דָרֶךְ הַהֹלְכִים בְּתוֹרַת ה'
"Fortunate are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Torah of Hashem"
"'And those who walk'—these are the masters of Scripture;
'on the way'—these are the masters of Mishnah;
for all their conversation is words of Torah."
That is, the Torah is called walking,
"who walk in the Torah of Hashem,"
בָּרָאתִי יֵצֶר הָרָע בָּרָאתִי לוֹ תּוֹרָה תַּבְלִין.
"I created the evil inclination; I created Torah as its spice."
וְהַיְינוּ הַיֵּצֶר שֶׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא,
That is, the inclination that the Holy One, blessed is He, created
so that it will direct that desire and yearning into words of Torah,
just as it will be in the future,
שֶׁיִּשָּׁאֵר הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע לִהְיוֹת חֲמִידוּ דְּאוֹרַיְיתָא
when the evil inclination will remain to become a yearning for Torah
And as they said in Midrash Tanchuma
"You say that it is evil, etc.
the Holy One, blessed is He, said:
וְעַל זֶה הָיָה דַּי בְּתוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב,
And for this, the Written Torah would have sufficed,
לֹא נִיתַּן לָהֶם אֶלָּא חֲמִשָּׁה חוּמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה וְכוּלֵּי.
they would have been given only the Five Books of the Torah, etc."
And this is what they said regarding the month of Sivan:
"He made the letter Zayin king in walking"
which refers to words of Torah
"and the left foot in the soul,"
and it stands to reason that the good one is to his right and the evil one to his left,"
לֵב חָכָם לִימִינוֹ וְלֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ.
"A wise man's heart is at his right, and a fool's heart is at his left."
וְזֶה בְּחֹדֶשׁ סִיוָן שֶׁהָיָה זְמַן מַתַּן תּוֹרָה,
And this was in the month of Sivan, which was the time of the Giving of the Torah,
וְהָיָה כָּלוּל בּוֹ כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה גַּם כֵּן.
and all of the Oral Torah was included within it as well.
And this is "'on the way'—these are the masters of Mishnah;
הַיְינוּ שֶׁכּוּלָּם בְּלוּלִים בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה כְּעִיסָּה בְּלִישָׁה,
meaning that they are all thoroughly kneaded into words of Torah like dough in kneading,
וְזֶה הָ"רֹב חָכְמָה" שֶׁבָּא לְתַקֵּן הָ"רֹב כַּעַס".
and this is the "abundance of wisdom" that comes to rectify the "abundance of anger."
And this is what is meant by "all their conversation is words of Torah."
And regarding this month it is written
הַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה לָכֶם רֹאשׁ חֳדָשִׁים רִאשׁוֹן הוּא לָכֶם לְחָדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה.
"This month shall be unto you the head of months; it shall be the first unto you of the months of the year."
And it is stated in the Pesikta
"Renew your deeds, for 'head' and 'first' are yet to come:
'first' refers to the wicked Esav, etc."
And that is because the husk of Nebuchadnezzar
is the counterpart to Chochmah (Wisdom) in holiness
וְלָכֵן בְּגָלוּת בָּבֶל שָׁם הִתְחִיל הִתְיַסְּדוּת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and therefore in the Babylonian exile, there began the establishment of the Oral Torah
through the craftsmen and the smiths (the Torah scholars).

p: And the Gemara is called the Babylonian Talmud,
for there was its primary foundation,
עָלָה עֶזְרָא מִבָּבֶל וְיִסְּדָהּ וְכוּלֵּי עָלָה הִלֵּל הַבַּבְלִי וְיִסְּדָהּ וְכוּלֵּי.
"Ezra came up from Babylon and established it, etc.; Hillel the Babylonian came up and established it, etc."
And regarding Ahasuerus it is stated
אָחִיו שֶׁל רֹאשׁ וּבֶן גִּילוֹ שֶׁל רֹאשׁ,
"Brother of the 'head' and peer of the 'head'
אָחִיו שֶׁל נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר הָרָשָׁע שֶׁנִּקְרָא רֹאשׁ וְכוּלֵּי,
brother of the wicked Nebuchadnezzar who was called 'head,' etc.;
הוּא הָרַג הוּא בִּיקֵּשׁ לַהֲרוֹג וְכוּלֵּי.
he killed, and this one sought to kill, etc."
And regarding Ahasuerus it is written
And this refers to the Oral Torah,
which is called "orah" with a Hei, in the feminine gender,
because it receives from the Written Torah.
"They re-accepted it in the days of Ahasuerus."
And this refers to the Oral Torah,
שֶׁעַל זֶה הָיְתָה כְּפִיַּית הָהָר כְּגִיגִית
over which the mountain was suspended like a vat
And "first" refers to the wicked Esav,
who in the realm of impurity corresponds to Kesser (Crown) in holiness,
because he was able to disguise himself,
לֹא כָּךְ הוּא הֲלָכָה וְכוּלֵּי לֹא כָּךְ אִיסּוּרוֹ לֹא כָּךְ הֶיתֵּרוֹ וְכוּלֵּי.
"Is not such the law, etc., is not such its prohibition, is not such its permission, etc.?"
וּבְוַדַּאי הָיָה יָכוֹל יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין אֱמֶת וָשֶׁקֶר,
And certainly our father Yitzchak, peace be upon him, was able to distinguish between truth and falsehood,
רַק שֶׁזֶּה הָיָה קְלִיפָּתוֹ שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהַסְתִּיר עַצְמוֹ.
except that this was his husk's power, that he was able to conceal himself.
לֶעָתִיד עֵשָׂו מִתְעַטֵּף בְּטַלִּיתוֹ כְּזָקֵן וְיוֹשֵׁב אֵצֶל יַעֲקֹב וְכוּלֵּי.
"In the future, Esav will wrap himself in his tallis like an elder and sit next to Yaakov, etc."
And regarding this month both "head" and "first" are written,
שֶׁזָּכוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחָכְמָה וְלִהְיוֹת קְשׁוּרִים בְּכֶתֶר עֶלְיוֹן
for Israel merited wisdom and to be bound to the Supernal Crown
after the Plague of the Firstborn,
when they were called "My firstborn son, Israel."
And so it is stated in the Gemara
שֶׁנֶּחְשַׁב שָׁם עֲשָׂרָה דְּבָרִים כְּנֶגֶד עֶשֶׂר סְפִירוֹת,
because ten things are enumerated there corresponding to the ten Sefiros,
And it began with "first of Creation"
and concludes with "first of the months"
כְּנֶגֶד מִדָּה אַחֲרוֹנָה קָרֵי לְהוֹן עֲטָרוֹת,
corresponding to the final attribute (Malchus), it calls them "crowns,"
שֶׁמִּלַּת רִאשׁוֹן מוֹרֶה עַל מִדַּת כֶּתֶר עֶלְיוֹן שֶׁהוּא רִאשׁוֹן.
for the word "first" indicates the attribute of Kesser Elyon, which is first.
